title: Ethics in conversation: Building an ethics assurance case for autonomous AI-enabled voice agents in healthcare
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the ethical evaluation of an AI system. It uses a structured 'principles-based ethics assurance argument pattern'—covering beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, and justice—to analyze the ethical acceptability of the Dora platform. This is a primary research focus on ethics and morality rather than a secondary considerations section.
